source_text: The benchmark panel separates implementation checks, an ideal Rouse reference, and published-figure replication. Solid curves show sampled reference trajectories; dashed curves show analytical predictions. The saved suite tests free diffusion, internal-chain motion, center-of-mass diffusion and illustrative static-loop suppression. These fixtures exercise the actual Brownian integrator but bypass the production forces and coupled reaction system. Passing them is evidence about implementation. It is not a reproduction of every figure in the cited paper, and it supplies no experimental clock.
